query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('session_id',s.id,'workspace_id',s.workspace_id,'conversation_id',s.conversation_id,'file_ids',ARRAY(SELECT u.file_id FROM assistant_uploads u WHERE u.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND u.session_id=s.id AND u.file_id IS NOT NULL AND u.state<>'cleaned')) AS "data!" FROM assistant_sessions s WHERE s.state<>'cleaned' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_uploads u WHERE u.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND u.session_id=s.id AND u.state='reserved' AND u.created_at>now()-interval '60 seconds') AND (s.state='closed' OR s.expires_at<=now() OR s.last_seen_at<=now()-interval '15 minutes' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=s.login_id AND t.expires_at>now()))  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources source WHERE source.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND source.session_id=s.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources source WHERE source.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND source.session_id=s.id AND (source.state='final' OR least(coalesce(s.closed_at,'infinity'::timestamptz),s.expires_at,s.last_seen_at+interval '15 minutes',coalesce((SELECT t.expires_at FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=s.login_id),now()))<=now()-interval '1 hour'))) ORDER BY s.cleanup_attempted_at NULLS FIRST,s.last_seen_at,s.id LIMIT 100
